classification_reason: Two independent builds into different directories produced the same world HEAD (13ad2fc…) and identical canonical trees. Their 20 derived files were byte-identical raw, timestamp-normalized and root-normalized. An extra generate under TZ=America/New_York with LC_ALL=C also produced a byte-identical generated/ tree.

consumer.goal: Build two worlds from the same inputs and compare HEADs and derived state
commands: generate in A; generate in B under TZ=America/New_York LC_ALL=C LANG=C; diff -rq A/generated B/generated
validate in B under TZ=Europe/Berlin and TZ=Asia/Tokyo
consumer.outcome: Builds are reproducible to the byte; derived views embed no absolute paths and no build-time clock ('Generated:' is the last-commit time).

internal.projection_activity: determinism.py built views in temporary copies of A and B; A and B each generated once in place

scenario_record.extra: generate under TZ=America/New_York LC_ALL=C: generated/ byte-identical to A. WS-NEGLECT day counts depend on wall-clock time (31/104 at 02:30Z, 32/105 at 11:05Z), not on TZ; they are baseline-exempt advisories and do not enter derived files.
